```json
 "topology": "Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS CS 2nd stage, nulling resistor)",
 "rationale": "Budget is 11 uA total: 1 uA ref, 1 uA tail, ~6.5 uA output stage, about 15 uW. Two stages give roughly 33+35 dB. GBW=gm1/Cc and needs only gm1 of about 7.5 uS, so Cc is about 0.9 pF. For PM, gm7 must exceed about 2.2*GBW*2pi*CL, roughly 83 uS. The PMOS output stage reaches that at gm/Id 13 with 6.5 uA. The Rz zero adds PM. Long-L mirrors keep W at or above 0.42 um at 1 uA."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L
    "Itail": (1.0e-6, 0.8e-6, 2e-6), # tail current
    "gmidp": (13.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # PMOS load / M7 gm/Id (same -> no systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # PMOS load / M7 L
    "I7":    (6.5e-6, 4e-6, 8e-6),   # second-stage current
    "Lm":    (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),        # NMOS bias mirror L
    "fgbw":  (1.3e6, 1.05e6, 2e6),   # target GBW -> sets Cc
    "kz":    (2.0, 0.8, 5.0),        # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 1e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    gmid_m = 10.0
    Lm = p["Lm"]; Lp = p["Lp"]
    I1 = p["Itail"] / 2

    # devices
    m9 = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, iref, vds=0.7)              # ref diode
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, p["Itail"], vds=0.4)        # tail
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, p["I7"], vds=0.9)           # output sink
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.4)       # input pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, I1, vds=0.9)            # mirror load (diode)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, p["I7"], vds=0.9)       # 2nd stage CS

    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["fgbw"])
    rz = p["kz"] / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")

    def put(name, d, g, s, b, op, typ):
        if op.W < 0.42:
            n.M(name, d, g, s, b, typ, 0.42, op.L)
        else:
            n.dev(name, d, g, s, b, op)

    # bias
    put("M9", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m9, "nfet")
    put("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5, "nfet")
    put("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8, "nfet")
    # first stage: vinp -> M1 drives the non-diode side (n1) so vout is non-inverting w.r.t. vinp
    put("M1", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1, "nfet")
    put("M2", "nd", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1, "nfet")
    put("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3, "pfet")
    put("M4", "n1", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3, "pfet")
    # second stage
    put("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7, "pfet")
    # compensation
    n.R("Rz", "n1", "nz", rz)
    n.C("Cc", "nz", "vout", cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain = db(A1 * A2)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m7.cgg
    p2 = gm7 * cc / (c1 * cc + cl * cc + c1 * cl) / (2 * PI)
    # zero from Rz: z = 1/(Cc*(1/gm7 - Rz)) -> LHP if Rz > 1/gm7
    denom = cc * (rz - 1.0 / gm7)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * denom) if denom > 0 else 1e12
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1) if c1 > 0 else 1e12
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / z)) \
            - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3))
    power = vdd * (iref + p["Itail"] + p["I7"])
    slew = min(p["Itail"] / cc, p["I7"] / (cl + cc))

    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}
```
